points: Boil a full kettle for the noodles.
Trim the pak choi, then thinly slice widthways.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Start the Prep

points: Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ½ tsp salt and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles to the water. Cook until tender, 4 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and run under cold water to stop the noodles sticking together.
steps.title: Cook the Noodles

points: Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan on medium-high heat (no oil).
Once hot, add the beef mince and green beans. Fry until browned and tender, 5-6 mins.
Use a spoon to break up the mince, then drain and discard any excess fat.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince. It's cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Bring on the Beef

points: Add the garlic and pak choi to the beef. Stir-fry for 1 min.
Pour in the teriyaki, soy sauce, sambal (add less if you'd prefer things milder) and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount).
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat slightly and simmer until the sauce has thickened, 2-3 mins.
steps.title: Flavour Town

points: Once the sauce has thickened, add the cooked noodles to the beef and toss to coat in the sauce.
Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
Add a splash of water if it's a little dry.
steps.title: Time to Toss

points: Share your sticky beef noodles between your bowls.
steps.title: Serve Up
